# Photographic architectural assets

All seven asset files are original downloads from official Poly Haven download URLs, verified against the MD5 hashes supplied by the official API. No image modifications or variants were generated.

License source: https://polyhaven.com/license

| Source | Artist | Resolution | Physical scale | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_overcast_puresky | Greg Zaal | 2048 × 1024 HDR | Environment panorama | Pure sky, soft overcast afternoon daylight, 5303 K white balance, 6 EV captured range. |
| https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02 | Rob Tuytel | 1024 × 1024 maps | 3 × 3 m per repeat | Gray asphalt with aggregate and fine cracks. |
| https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_pavement | Charlotte Baglioni | 1024 × 1024 maps | 1.8 × 1.8 m per repeat | Warm gray-beige concrete paving with fine joints. |

Total asset payload: 15311795 bytes (15.31 MB).

Diffuse maps are JPEG. OpenGL normal maps are lossless PNG. Roughness maps are grayscale JPEG.
Diffuse maps need sRGB decoding; normal and roughness maps are non-color data.
The full square UV repeat corresponds to the physical scales above.

Detailed local paths, original download URLs, exact byte sizes and hashes are recorded in manifest.json. Raw official file and metadata API responses are retained beside the assets.
